correctness.rationale: For the original unrelaxed zero-linear-operator SAV recurrence on f(x)=x²/2, set t=1/h and A=x²+2C. The updates rationalize to r_{k+1}=r_k tA/(x²+tA), x_{k+1}=x_k−2r_k sqrt(A/2)x/(x²+tA). The exact first step yields x1=a(t(a²+2C)−2C)/(a²+t(a²+2C)) and r1=O(t); the second yields r2=O(t²) and x2=−2C/a+[(a²+2C)²/a³](1+|a|/sqrt(2C))t+O(t²). For b=−2C/a≠0 an invariant compact interval around b bounds all subsequent shrink factors r_{k+1}/r_k≤tR; the entire infinite x-tail from step2 is O(t²), hence x∞≠0 and r_k→0. The exact a=C=1,h=20 rational/square-root witness traps all subsequent steps. Independently evaluated the recurrence at steps h=50..5000: h(x∞+2) converges numerically toward 9(1+1/sqrt2), corroborating—not proving—the expansion. The source paper's Theorem1 certifies r² decay, not stationarity if r∞=0.
